items.title: A.B. Spellman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 19, 2022
items.q: we got to be friends, I don’t know why because he was a year ahead of me, I don’t know why he took me in but he did.

ctx.x: And is that something, from a practical sense, that you felt you could make a living at?

No. Not at all. I did not at all think about making a living. I just thought that I wanted to write. I didn’t want — I left home, left Elizabeth City, North Carolina in 1952 to go to Howard University to study to be pre-med. The high school I went to in Elizabeth City was really very poor and extremely easy for me. I didn’t even take my books home at night and I was valedictorian. So when I got to college there I was without a study habit to my name and I really bombed out in pre-med you know because I really did…

thigh and nine inches at the cuff and it was a blue and white herringbone jacket against a powder blue pair of pants with one dark blue stitch going down the side which sort of pulled the outfit together, and a pair of alligator suede wingtips. And I knew I was sharp. And I got to campus and everybody’s in Brooks Brothers. Or it might not have been Brooks Brothers, it might have been, I don’t know, J. Crew or whatever cheaper versions of it are but I was immediately out of place. And that’s what I was wearing…
